title: Analytical Foundations of Magnetoelastic Material Models
exact_target: Provide analytical foundations for magnetic saturation, scale coupling, dissipation, minimization, hysteresis, nucleation and composite magnetoelastic limits.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003262 (OWR-15172-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Mathematics of Magnetoelastic Materials (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/51, pp. 2909--2940. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 2.
Bresciani 2023 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Rybka and Luskin 2005 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: All six coupled research questions are retained. The report does not supply a single universal energy or dissipation potential in this extraction; such a choice is part of model development, not an implicit hypothesis common to all materials.
